settings.question: What is B-Rewards?
settings.answer:
B-Rewards is our free-to-join Loyalty program. As a member, you’ll earn points for activities like shopping, leaving reviews, following us on social, and more.

You can redeem your points to earn discounts on future purchases.

settings.question: Who can join?
settings.answer:
The B-Rewards program is available to everyone—click here to get started.

Customers with a Bloch account are automatically enrolled in the program, no additional sign-up needed.

settings.question: Where can I report a problem or give feedback?
How do I leave the program?
settings.answer: If you no longer wish to earn points, please contact us at us@blochworld.com and ask to be unenrolled in the B-Rewards Loyalty Program. We'll unenroll you and you will lose any points you have accrued.

settings.question: What happens if I leave and decide to join again?
settings.answer: Just contact us at us@blochworld.com and we'll re-enroll you. However, your point total will begin from zero.

settings.question: How do I earn points?
settings.answer:
You can earn points for all sorts of activities including making a purchase, writing a review, signing up for email, liking Bloch's social channels, and referring a friend.

To see all the ways you can earn points click the Earn Points tab in the menu.

settings.question: Why do the points I received not match my total order value?
settings.answer: Points are only awarded for the cost of the item and excludes tax and shipping charges.

settings.question: How do I view my point balance?
settings.answer: Sign in to your Bloch account to check your balance.

question_HzJAQn.name: How do I redeem my points?

settings.question: How do I redeem my points?
settings.answer:
Look for the Redeem My Points section in your cart at checkout to apply your points to an order.

Note that points cannot be combined with other discounts or promotions.

settings.question: Is there a limit to the number of points I can earn?
settings.answer: No. Go ahead and earn as many as you can!

settings.question: Do my points expire?
settings.answer: Yes. Points are valid for 12 months from the date they are added to your account.

question_MxAWTE.name: How do I see my tier?

settings.question: How do I see which tier I'm in?
settings.answer: Sign in to your Bloch account to see your tier status.

question_eaBe4X.name: How long do I qualify for each tier?

settings.question: How long do I qualify for each tier?
settings.answer: Once you qualify for a tier, you'll retain your status for one full year.

settings.question: How do I use my "Buy 2, get 1 Free" on tights benefit?
settings.answer:
Tier specific benefits, like Buy 2, get 1 Free on Tights, will automatically be applied at checkout when logged into your account.

It is applicable on full priced dance tights for ladies and girls. The lowest priced item is free of charge, and discount is automatically applied at checkout.

settings.question: How do I use my free shipping benefit?
settings.answer: Tier-specific benefits, like free shipping, will automatically be applied at checkout when logged into your account.

settings.question: What do the 'approved', 'pending' and 'cancelled' statuses mean?
settings.answer:
• Approved: These points can be redeemed on rewards immediately

  • Pending: These points need to be verified before you can redeem them. All purchases will be pending for 30 days to account for any items you may want to return. You can only earn points on purchases that you have not returned.

  • Cancelled: These points will not be added to your account. For example, this will happen if you cancel or return a purchase (the points will change from pending to cancelled)

settings.question: Why did my account balance go down?
settings.answer: You may have cancelled or returned a purchase.

settings.question: I completed an activity but didn't earn points.
settings.answer: It can sometimes take a few minutes for us to process your activity and provide your points.
